title: Architecture log row
description: One row in .kaizen/workflow/progress.md. Rendered as `| <date> | <kind> | <loc> | <summary> |` and appended atomically by kaizen-progress append. Validated BEFORE write — invalid payloads exit 1 + reject without touching the file.

summary.description: One-line summary. MUST NOT contain `: ` (colon-space) — that trips YAML / table-cell parsers downstream. Use ` — ` (em-dash) or `;` instead.
